profile.headline: Software Developer In Test at Ingo Money
profile.summary: High energy, self-efficient learner, and extremely devoted worker that thrives for efficiency and best practices in all aspects of production. I adjust well to ever-changing world of technology and enjoy new challenges that continue my growth in my career path in Testing and Development.

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer II
positions.description:
- Point of contact for all escalations and accountable for the development and training of two onshore automation resources while leading multiple projects.
- Responsible for reviewing, approving, denying, and deciding best test coverage for our regression suites to ensure proper, efficient testing
- Interacted closely with all manual team leads and testers onshore/offshore for quality production from the automation efforts requested
- Implemented generic template automation framework to support a large launch of several clients with the same code base 
- Implemeneted SQA department wide Test Coverage Analysis interface that interacted with Quality Center to present over coverage of critical areas for all tested products. 
- Implemented an Object Repository GUI interface to interact with our in-house Selenium Framework solution.
- Lead developer on a drag and drop tool that allowed manual user to create, debug, and copy automation test scripts in Quality Center through the use of our in-house Selenium Framework solution. 
- Technical lead of our Cucumber automated framework
- Responsible for developing tools and conducted trainings to support multiple delivery teams in our Cucumber Automation Framework implementation

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer I
positions.description:
- Responsible for creating the stand-up automation framework in QuickTest Pro using VBScript for PeopleSoft HR and PeopleSoft Position Management, 
- Created the regression suite testing critical areas in PeopleSoft HR and PeopleSoft Position Management. Increased suite size by 140 test scripts for better testing coverage and reducing execution times for regression cycle by 75% depending on the system's stability and virtual lab machine availability in less than a 4 month time frame
- Created a template-based GUI interface for PeopleSoft HR to replicate all Quality Center information from a manual test case and convert to create automated smoke tests using VB, OTA Client, and Excel Sheets to store all information for sign off.
- Held responsibilities as the Automation Test Lead to meet bi-weekly with the Manual Test Leads for  new work intake of critical areas of testing that may be impacted. 
- Responsible for making sure all releases using automated test scripts were executed, assisted with debugging automations scripts, and improved automation framework to provide better testing efficiencies
- Responsible for conducting technical training for new hires on our internal Quick Test Professional Automation Framework

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Associate
positions.description:
- Responsible for learning and maintaining company operations, testing methodologies, and a vast amount of information from various departments and their functions
- Reviewed newly created regression test cases and approved test cases for our regression suite using Quality Center 10
- Created and executed automated test cases using QuickTest Professional 11
- Attended bi-weekly meetings alongside team lead and manual team leads in the applications teams I assisted
- Ability to recognize, assess, and escalate issues to the proper channels
- Able to identify potential issues and increase functional test coverage 
- Participated in code reviews and bi-weekly 1:1's with managers
- Assisted in development in creating a new automation framework to increase testing speed and reliability with detailed reporting to help identify bugs and defects

positions.title: Web Developer Free Lancer
positions.description:
- Self-taught PHP and MySQL concepts to develop an understanding with these technologies while applying for jobs after college.
- Worked with a client as an intern (unpaid) to get experience demonstrating skills in PHP and MySQL alongside another recent graduate.
- Used Tortoise SVN as version control and had weekly calls to the client and various communication with other graduate
- Worked on a startup website as our project

positions.title: Web Software Developer - Internship
positions.description:
- Assigned to maintain the functionality for the company website using Dreamweaver and HTML
- Responsible for producing a technical repot, including a flow chart with completed documentation for creating login script using a PHP front-end and a MySQL backend-end database
- Completed and received CompTIA 2007 certification
- Attended daily stand up meetings to present updates, issues, and new solutions
